Why: opioids relieve pain through the μ receptor
Note: Opioids reduce OA pain more than placebo, though by less than the minimal important difference; the endogenous peripheral opioid system masks OA pain in mice. Long use can bring opioid-induced hyperalgesia (Angst 2006).
References: da Costa BR et al. Oral or transdermal opioids for osteoarthritis of the knee or hip. Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2014. 2014. doi: 10.1002/14651858.CD003115.pub4.
